evidence.source: Official report from the Civil Aviation Authority.
evidence.text: Vanguard Aviation achieved a safety inspection score of 95 points on its annual evaluation.

evidence.source: Official registry of the Global Flight Safety Council.
evidence.text: Vanguard Aviation holds an active Gold Safety Accreditation.

evidence.source: Official registry of the Maritime Transport Authority.
evidence.text: Solaria Cruises maintains an active vessel fleet total of 12 ships.

memories.text: Vanguard Aviation is approved as a preferred flight provider.
Vanguard Aviation is designated to conduct VIP flight operations.
Solaria Cruises satisfies tier-one maritime logistics criteria.

updates.source: Official notification from the Global Flight Safety Council.
updates.text: The Global Flight Safety Council retracted Vanguard Aviation's Gold Safety Accreditation.

updates.source: Official bulletin from the Civil Aviation Authority.
updates.text: The Civil Aviation Authority invalidated Vanguard Aviation's safety inspection score of 95 points on its annual evaluation.

policies.text: Classification as a top-tier maritime carrier is awarded to a cruise operator whose active vessel fleet total is at least 10 ships.
Qualified status as a favored aviation vendor is granted to any carrier holding Gold Safety Accreditation or attaining an annual safety inspection score of 90 points or higher.
Priority customs clearing is extended to cargo handlers that maintain a customs accuracy rating of 98 percent or above.
Allocation of premier corporate air travel requires an operator with favored aviation vendor standing.
A ground transit vendor qualifies for express dispatch authorization if its active van fleet total reaches 25 vehicles.
